#include <string>
#include <stdexcept>

int main() {
    std::string str;
    std::getline(std::cin, str);
    
    int result = 0;
    int i = 0;
    while (i < str.length()) {
        int j = i + 1;
        while (j < str.length() && str[i] == str[j]) {
            j++;
        }
        result += (j - i + 1) % 2;
        i = j;
    }
    std::cout << result << std::endl;
    
    return 0;
}
